title: Finite ordinary realization of an intrinsic labeled local rule
statement: Fix a totally ordered set $L$, a synchronized embedded resolution assignment $E$ [def-trf-labeled-embedded-resolution], and an intrinsic assignment $I$ associated to $E$ [def-trf-intrinsic-labeled-resolution]. There exists a local ordinary rule $B$ in the sense of [def-trf-labeled-ordinary-resolution-descent-data]. For every rational input $S$ [def-trf-ordinary-resolution-rule], proof that $S$ is embeddable, and permitted embedding $p$ of $S$, the ordinary tower of $B(S)$ and its increasing label embedding are exactly the ordinary tower and label embedding of $I(S)$ (using $p$ only to witness membership in the intrinsic domain). Equality here is equality of the `LabeledOrdinaryTower` data of [def-trf-labeled-ordinary-zariski-resolution-data], not just terminal-scheme isomorphism. Thus $B$ has the supplied regular centers and final scheme, coherent center ideals [pqf-def-coherent], and labeled finite-index cartesian comparisons for all smooth rational morphisms between embeddable inputs. No global descent or global smooth coherence is asserted.

proof.text: The embedding predicates are equivalent: compose a permitted source isomorphism with its closed immersion, or use the identity source isomorphism for a literal embedding. Set the finite tower and labels to the corresponding projections of I.tower. Membership witnesses are proofs, so proof irrelevance identifies all such choices. Transport the cut-center coherence condition along its stage isomorphism and center_ordinary; identify scheme restriction with the equivalent ringed-space slice to obtain the coherent-center predicate. Regularity is I.tower.resolves. Empty and regular inputs have length zero by its supplied fields.

proof.text: For a smooth map take I.comparison. Its retained-label clause embeds the finite source label list into the target list in order. At target level i choose the cut before target label i, and use the full cut at the final level. Count the source labels in this cut. The index-label equivalence gives both endpoint equations, the count equations before/after retained stages and constancy at a deleted stage. This includes length zero, where the level index set is a singleton.

proof.text: Conjugate the cut natural transformation by its stage isomorphisms to obtain the finite level maps. Cartesian squares transport along these isomorphisms. The stage naturality and transformation naturality give transition naturality. Transport the equality of cut centers through center_ordinary and functorial ideal comap to obtain the retained-center equation. The retained-label predicate says exactly that the extended ideal is nonunit, giving deleted_iff_unit. Label equality follows from the survivor embedding. These fields form B, with the stated literal labeled-tower equality.

lean.statement: theorem intrinsicResolution_ordinary_localRule (L : Type w) [LinearOrder L] (E : SynchronizedEmbeddedResolution.{u, w} L) (I : IntrinsicResolutionOfEmbedded L E) : ∃ B : OrdinaryResolutionDescent.LocalRule.{u, w} L, (∀ (S : RationalResolutionInput.{u}) (eS : OrdinaryResolutionDescent.Embeddable S) (p : RationalResolutionEmbedding S), (⟨(B.tower S eS).tower, (B.tower S eS).labels⟩ : LabeledOrdinaryTower L S.scheme) = ⟨(I.tower ⟨S, ⟨p⟩⟩).ordinary, (I.tower ⟨S, ⟨p⟩⟩).label⟩)
